mapper.select: SELECT id, result_id, name, scene_state::text AS scene_state, version, created_at, updated_at FROM viewer_plan WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM viewer_plan WHERE id = #{id} AND result_id = #{resultId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO viewer_plan (id, result_id, name, scene_state, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{resultId}, #{name}, CAST(#{sceneState} AS jsonb), #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM viewer_plan WHERE id = #{id} AND result_id = #{resultId}
